dinner.name: Asado (Argentine Grilled Beef)
dinner.description: Argentine grilled beef with chimichurri - national pride dish
ingredients: 1.5kg beef short ribs or rib eye steak (2cm thick)
Salt and black pepper to taste

For chimichurri: 1 cup fresh parsley, finely chopped, 1/4 cup fresh oregano, finely chopped, 6 cloves garlic, minced, 3/4 cup extra virgin olive oil, 1/4 cup red wine vinegar, 1/2 teaspoon red pepper flakes, Salt and pepper to taste
instructions: Make chimichurri: combine parsley, oregano, minced garlic in bowl
Add olive oil, red wine vinegar, red pepper flakes
Let chimichurri sit at least 30 minutes to blend flavors (can be made hours ahead)
Prepare grill for medium-high heat (wood charcoal is traditional)
Pat beef dry with paper towels
Season beef generously with salt and pepper on both sides
Place beef on hot grill grates
Grill 25-30 minutes for medium-rare (internal temp 130-135°F), turning occasionally
Do not move meat constantly - let it develop char
Remove beef from grill and let rest 10 minutes (crucial for meat texture)
Serve immediately with chimichurri on the side or spooned over meat
Traditional accompaniments: grilled vegetables, salad, crusty bread
dinner.notes: Chimichurri is essential - it's the soul of the dish. Resting meat allows juices to redistribute
dinner.fun_fact: Asado is more than food in Argentina - it's a social and cultural tradition bringing people together
